A flashback to the Bears-Panthers 2023 blockbuster trade ahead of today’s matchup:

Panthers receive:
🏈 2023 No. 1 pick (Bryce Young)

Bears receive:
🏈 WR DJ Moore
🏈 2023 first-round pick (OT Darnell Wright)
🏈 2023 second-round pick (CB Tyrique Stevenson)
🏈 2024 first-round pick (QB Caleb Williams)
🏈 2025 second-round pick (WR Luther Burden)
Joey Porter Jr. inactive for Week 1.

Garafolo: Alec Pierce (heel) will be on pitch count in Week 1.

Expected to play around 20-30 plays.
That would be an excellent outcome.
When the Rams play next Monday night vs. the Giants, they will be without Myles Garrett but they very well could have back Aaron Donald.

Cooper Rush will be Atlanta’s starting quarterback today, undrafted free agent Jack Strand will be the backup, and with Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix Jr. both inactive, wide receiver Olamide Zaccheaus will be the Falcons’ emergency quarterback vs. the Steelers.

But Zaccheus’ role doesn’t stop just there. With the Falcons also having only two running backs active today, Bijan Robinson and Brian Robinson, Zaccheus also will be the team’s emergency third-string running back.
Sunday 1 on the journey to Los Angeles and Super Bowl LXI. https://t.co/Wld9zTFfDQ
Joey Porter Jr. officially is inactive today.

While CJ Stroud was more than open to a deal and wants to be in Houston long term, the looming quarterback market for the 2027 season had an effect on his decision. A quarterback contract with a $70 million average annual value is not an impossibility for next offseason.

Alvin Kamara (knee) inactive for Week 1.
Myles Garrett is now set to miss games against the Giants, Broncos, Eagles and Bills. L.A. hosts the Cardinals in Week 6.

Asante Samuel Jr. is in line to start for the Steelers at corner in place of Joey Porter Jr., per source. He’s had a strong preseason.

#49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling, who left the opener early with an injury, is out at least a month with a deltoid sprain in his ankle, sources say. 

Stribling is still seeking opinions, and while surgery is not currently planned, it is possible. SF will be cautious. https://t.co/adUmcDQS7Q
Including the playoffs, Matthew Golden ranked as WR5 in EPA per target (minimum 40 targets) in 2025.
NFL friends… We back. https://t.co/UW57nlgfD9
Pelissero: Myles Garrett will undergo arthroscopic surgery on knee and will be placed on IR.

Rams star Myles Garrett will undergo arthroscopic surgery on his ailing knee and is headed to injured reserve, sources tell @ringer @netflixsports.

Garrett has been dealing with lower-leg pain and wasn’t himself in Thursday’s opener. The hope is he’s back in four weeks. https://t.co/naTKJDV06R

Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr., who has been embroiled in a contract dispute all summer, is unlikely to play Sunday against the Falcons because of a back injury, per @RapSheet and me, and the possibility of a trade remains in play. https://t.co/Iin8JJMzw3
Bears WR Rome Odunze officially is active today.
The Joey Porter Jr. situation has been brewing. This is from my Sept. 2 piece wrapping up contracts around the league. https://t.co/t8TrRhInOj

The two biggest trades of the offseason were Myles Garrett to the Rams and AJ Brown to the Patriots.

Both players have been placed on IR after just one game played. 

Tough starts.
#Rams star Myles Garrett will undergo knee surgery to fix what had limited him in training camp and he's headed to IR, sources say. https://t.co/YAGwoEvF4C
#Bears WR Rome Odunze, questionable with a calf injury, is expected to go today against the #Panthers, source said.
ESPN's Sunday NFL Countdown, Week 1: https://t.co/ukRkqMYV4S

After undergoing a meniscus trim Tuesday, the Raiders believe there’s a realistic chance Brock Bowers will miss only one game and return for Week 2 at the Los Angeles Chargers, per sources. Team will see how he’s feeling this week, but a potential return next week is within the realm of possibility.
Rams standout Myles Garrett will undergo arthroscopic surgery on his knee and will be placed on injured reserve sidelining him a minimum of four games, as @TomPelissero reported.

The full story on #49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling, who is out a month: https://t.co/FhMKwl7KJW

https://t.co/FhMKwl7KJW
20-30 plays expected for Alec Pierce (heel)

While Packers running back Josh Jacobs remains on the Commissioner Exempt list, the NFL could count time spent there as time served for any potential suspension. Some league sources expect this to be the case in the end. In the Collective Bargaining Agreement, there is a six-game minimum for any type of domestic violence. It could be more or less, depending on mitigating factors.

Maxx Crosby will play today for the #Raiders, ending a rollercoaster offseason. And that's because after the nixed #Ravens trade, Crosby told interested teams -- including the #Rams -- he did not want to be traded.

Story: https://t.co/LujBrWsByB

https://t.co/LujBrWsByB

#Saints RB Alvin Kamara, who is questionable with a knee injury because of an MCL sprain, is not expected to play today against the #Lions, sources say. He was a full participant late in the week, but was not quite ready.

From @NFLGameDay Morning: Injury updates from this week, as #Seaahawks QB Sam Darnold actually has a glute injury, #Patriots WR AJ Brown is out about six weeks, and #49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling (deltoid ligament) is out at least a month. https://t.co/0VlHlIzgw7

Falcons QB Cooper Rush, who experienced back spasms Saturday morning, is said to be feeling better this morning and is expected to be ready to start today’s opener against the Steelers, per source. https://t.co/lT2MD0iE1q
The sides haven’t been close and today was the #Steelers’ deadline to get a contract done. Porter Jr. is out today with a back injury.
And #AZCardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love, questionable with an ankle sprain, is expected to play.

#Steelers star CB Joey Porter Jr is unlikely to play today against the #Falcons, per me and @AdamSchefter, as his back injury and the associated ramp up keep him on the sidelines. And a trade is a possibility. https://t.co/5yIhxnFkRm

Doyle rules: Declan calling his first regular-season game for the #Ravens. Dillon and the #Colts’ defensive coaches trying to stop them. Will have more on the brothers squaring off in Week 1 on @NFLGameDay Morning. https://t.co/v2x66PEfov

Some of that will be based on how he feels in-game. Will likely get spells here and there.
Bears starting safety Xavier Woods (groin) is considered a game-time decision but there’s optimism he’ll be able to play, per source.

Sometimes we’re told “true game-time decision” and it’s a stall tactic. And sometimes teams truly don’t know until closer to game time. I honestly believe it’s the latter for the #Giants here, hoping Malik Nabers can be a go. Not ideal for fantasy purposes, I get it. But reality.

From @NFLGameDay Morning (in-studio!): The #Falcons won’t have QB Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) today, but Michael Penix Jr could next week or Week 3; Meanwhile, the NFL is attempting to obtain the Josh Jacobs video for its investigation. https://t.co/fqGbuA1Rv8

Lamar Jackson and the Ravens have yet to engage in any substantive, significant discussions about a long-term contract extension that would give him a chance to finish his career in Baltimore.
